svg.text: CHANGING THIS RE-EVALUATES EVERY COMPLETED TASK AGAINST THE NEW VALUE.
THE SAME CONTROL IS IN SETTINGS; THE NUMBER NEVER LIVES IN TWO PLACES.
— An archived task keeps its whole control description.
— Restore puts it back with every row, into the lists it still qualifies for.
— Deleting is a separate, explicit act on the task itself.

a part you rejected, never re-proposed

which engine proposed it, named not coloured
